title: Kiln Hugging Face Next-Token Request v1
description: Exact input contract for an independent eager Hugging Face next-token comparison. It binds the source revision, model bytes, rendered prompt, continuation prefix, and disputed Kiln and vLLM candidates; the oracle result is recorded separately.

schema.description: Schema identifier for this request format.

id.description: Stable, path-safe identifier for this attribution request.

source.description: Source revision and qualification receipts that produced the two disputed candidate tokens.

source_commit.description: Full Git commit hash shared by the candidate-producing Kiln and vLLM qualification runs.

kiln_receipt.description: Repository-relative Kiln qualification receipt and its file and canonical-content hashes.

vllm_receipt.description: Repository-relative vLLM qualification receipt and its file and canonical-content hashes.

model_identity.description: Content identity of the exact model, tokenizer, chat template, configuration, and weight shards used for attribution.

prompt.description: Single-user prompt recipe and the exact rendered token sequence before the continuation prefix is appended.

generator.description: Deterministic benchmark-generator coordinates that identify how this prompt was selected and rendered.

run_id.description: Identifier of the benchmark generation run that emitted the prompt.

phase.description: Named generation phase within the benchmark run.

request_index.description: Zero-based prompt index; this attribution contract is fixed to the first short-profile request.

profile.description: Serving workload profile used to generate the disputed request.

template_version.description: Version of the deterministic serving-profile prompt generator.

messages.description: The single user message passed to the chat template.

role.description: Chat role for the only input message.

content.description: Nonempty user-message text before chat-template rendering.

add_generation_prompt.description: Whether chat-template rendering appends the assistant-generation marker; fixed to true for this attribution.

template_kwargs.description: Chat-template options fixed by the qualification workload.

enable_thinking.description: Whether the chat template opens a reasoning span; fixed to false for this comparison.

utf8_sha256.description: SHA-256 identity of the exact UTF-8 rendered prompt before tokenization.

token_count.description: Number of tokens in the rendered prompt, excluding the continuation prefix.

token_ids.description: Exact tokenizer output for the rendered prompt, excluding the continuation prefix.

continuation_prefix.description: Ordered token sequence forced after the rendered prompt to reproduce the first divergent next-token state.

input_token_ids.description: Complete oracle input: the rendered prompt token IDs followed by the continuation-prefix token IDs.

input_token_ids_sha256.description: SHA-256 identity of the canonical complete input-token sequence.

candidates.description: Exactly two disputed next-token candidates, ordered as Kiln first and vLLM second.

engine.description: The first candidate must come from Kiln.
The second candidate must come from vLLM.

sha256.description: Lowercase SHA-256 digest with the `sha256:` algorithm prefix.

tokenId.description: Tokenizer vocabulary ID for the bound Qwen3.5-4B model identity.

tokenIds.description: Bounded, nonempty sequence of tokenizer vocabulary IDs.

token.description: One continuation token represented by both vocabulary ID and decoded text.

token_id.description: Vocabulary ID of this continuation token.

text.description: Tokenizer-decoded text for this token; it may be empty or contain nonprinting content.

candidate.description: One engine's disputed next-token prediction at the bound prompt and continuation state.

token_id.description: Vocabulary ID predicted by the named engine.

text.description: Tokenizer-decoded text for the predicted token.

receiptReference.description: Repository-relative qualification receipt with hashes of both its file bytes and canonical content.

path.description: Repository-relative path to the retained receipt.

file_sha256.description: SHA-256 identity of the receipt file's exact bytes.

content_sha256.description: SHA-256 identity of the receipt's canonical content, excluding incidental serialization differences.

weightFile.description: One model weight shard and its exact size and content identity.

path.description: Path or stable shard name within the bound model source.

sha256.description: SHA-256 identity of the shard's exact bytes.

modelIdentity.description: Complete content identity for the model inputs used by every candidate and oracle process.

id.description: Human-readable model identifier recorded alongside the content hashes.

content_sha256.description: Aggregate content identity for the complete model source.

config_hash.description: SHA-256 identity of the effective model configuration.

tokenizer_hash.description: SHA-256 identity of the tokenizer inputs.

chat_template_hash.description: SHA-256 identity of the chat template used to render the prompt.

weight_files.description: Complete ordered inventory of model weight shards.
